entries.title: Genesis 5:1
segments: ¶This is the book of Adam's generations. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him.

entries.title: Genesis 5:2
segments: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

entries.title: Genesis 5:3
segments: And Adam lived a hundred and thirty years, and begot [a son] in his likeness, after his image, and called his name Seth.

entries.title: Genesis 5:4
segments: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years; and he begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:5
segments: And all the days of Adam that he lived were nine hundred and thirty years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:6
segments: ¶And Seth lived a hundred and five years, and begot Enosh.

entries.title: Genesis 5:7
segments: And Seth lived after he had begotten Enosh eight hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:8
segments: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:9
segments: And Enosh lived ninety years, and begot Cainan.

entries.title: Genesis 5:10
segments: And Enosh lived after he had begotten Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:11
segments: And all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:12
segments: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begot Mahalaleel.

entries.title: Genesis 5:13
segments: And Cainan lived after he had begotten Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:14
segments: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:15
segments: And Mahalaleel lived sixty-five years, and begot Jared.

entries.title: Genesis 5:16
segments: And Mahalaleel lived after he had begotten Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:17
segments: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred and ninety-five years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:18
segments: And Jared lived a hundred and sixty-two years, and begot Enoch.

entries.title: Genesis 5:19
segments: And Jared lived after he had begotten Enoch eight hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:20
segments: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:21
segments: ¶And Enoch lived sixty-five years, and begot Methushelah.

entries.title: Genesis 5:22
segments: And Enoch walked with God after he had begotten Methushelah three hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:23
segments: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.

entries.title: Genesis 5:24
segments: And Enoch walked with God; and he was not, for God took him.

entries.title: Genesis 5:25
segments: ¶And Methushelah lived a hundred and eighty-seven years, and begot Lemech.

entries.title: Genesis 5:26
segments: And Methushelah lived after he had begotten Lemech seven hundred and eighty-two years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:27
segments: And all the days of Methushelah were nine hundred and sixty-nine years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:28
segments: ¶And Lemech lived a hundred and eighty-two years, and begot a son.

entries.title: Genesis 5:29
segments: And he called his name Noah, saying, This [one] shall comfort us concerning our work and concerning the toil of our hands, because of the ground which Jehovah has cursed.

entries.title: Genesis 5:30
segments: And Lemech lived after he had begotten Noah five hundred and ninety-five years, and begot sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:31
segments: And all the days of Lemech were seven hundred and seventy-seven years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:32
segments: And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah begot Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
